descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S10 「零个病人和十二个病人，两个模式」 Zero patients and twelve patients, both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 From the home screen, one tap on 'Handoff' generates summaries for the physician's patients in one action, not one patient at a time.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U10 Handoff AI calls follow 3.5/3.9: timings are targets with 30 s as the upper limit for investigation; each call logs the AI provider's own time separately from the total and which model answered; …（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Account A with no Hospital patients and no In-Today residents; account B with 12 Hospital patients and 12 In-Today residents

When A opens Handoff in both contexts; B opens Handoff in each context and waits for generation

Then A: the empty state ('No patients to hand off.', '0 patients' / '0 residents'), Send disabled, nothing stuck on 'Generating', no other account's patients; B: all 12 on one sheet from one tap, Send enabled, and the wait from tap to Send enabled is recorded

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: A's checkpoints need the empty-state text, the zero count and a disabled Send ('button "Send to…" [disabled]', the MCP snapshot form), and must not show 'Generating', 'undefined', 'QA Hosp', 'QA Resident'; the empty-state wording itself is judged by a human (no UAT text). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：PERF · 性能计时 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
